answer: Registration also requires solving a marble challenge tied to that agent's history, so creating a new identity costs fresh mining plus challenge effort rather than a free copy. Each agent must lock a unique quartz token on a public ledge before voting, where the token is mined only through sustained work and cannot be transferred or duplicated. An attacker flooding the network pays that full cost per fake agent, making sybil swarms economically ruinous while honest agents recover value through normal participation. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
